name: leather bracers
_design_note: F1-25 light arms slot. Oil-hardened leather forearm guards. Bracers_of_Cu_Chulainn uses this as template_basis.
lore_template: Bracers of {material_name} are strapped from wrist to elbow, over the tendons that a glancing blade finds first. Archers wear the like for a humbler reason, to save the arm from the slap of the bowstring.
